## Allele specific expression ###
```{r}
base_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/quantification_rsem/as_forw"

# Get full file paths
file_paths <- list.files(base_dir, pattern = "\\.genes\\.results$", 
                         recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

# Read samples using full paths
all_quant_data <- map(file_paths, function(file_path) {
  sample_id <- basename(file_path) %>% str_remove("\\.genes\\.results$")
  
  quant_file <- read.table(file_path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>%
    mutate(
      genome = str_extract(gene_id, "(?<=_)[^_]+$"),
      ID = str_remove(gene_id, "_[^_]+$"),
      sample_id = sample_id
    )
  
  cat("Processed:", file_path, "| Sample:", sample_id, "| Total reads:", sum(quant_file$expected_count), "\n")
  return(quant_file)
})

# Combine all data into one dataframe
combined_quant_data <- bind_rows(all_quant_data)

# Reshape for analysis with both TPM and expected_count
reshaped_allele_specific_expr <- combined_quant_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, sample_id, genome, TPM, expected_count) 

## Calculate CPM 
reshaped_allele_specific_expr_cpm <- reshaped_allele_specific_expr %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, genome) %>% 
  mutate(CPM = (expected_count / sum(expected_count)) * 1e6) %>%
  ungroup()

#write.csv2(reshaped_allele_specific_expr,"/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/quantification/counts/reshaped_allele_specific_expr.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

## Add information about samples
```{r}
sampledata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/tm3_phenotype_preprocessed_based_on_pca_with_selfers_v2.csv",header=T)
sampledata <- sampledata %>% dplyr::select(Sample_id,Accession,Variant,Genotype)
reshaped_allele_specific_expr_cpm$sample_id <- as.numeric(reshaped_allele_specific_expr_cpm$sample_id) # Make sample id numeric
reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo <- inner_join(reshaped_allele_specific_expr_cpm,sampledata,by=c("sample_id"="Sample_id"))
```
## Filter gene and TEs to have at least n reads per condition 
```{r}
# Calculate 5% of samples threshold
total_samples <- length(unique(reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo$sample_id))
min_samples_threshold <- ceiling(total_samples * 0.05)  # 5% of samples

cat("Total samples:", total_samples, "\n")
cat("Minimum samples threshold (5%):", min_samples_threshold, "\n")

# Filter: expected_count >= 10 in at least 5% of samples per gene
reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered <- reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  filter(sum(expected_count >= 10) >= min_samples_threshold) %>%
  ungroup()

str(unique(reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo$ID))
str(unique(reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered$ID))

# Select TEs 
tes <- grepl("AT[1-9]TE", reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered$ID)
reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered_tes <- reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered[tes,]
str(unique(reshaped_data_with_sampleinfo_filtered_tes$ID))


```

### Get maternally expressed TEs 
## Calculate maternal ratios 

```{r}
library(tidyr)
## Reshape data 
boxplot_data$acc <- ifelse(boxplot_data$genome=="tair10", "tair10", "accession")

reshaped_data <- boxplot_data %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, Variant, Genotype, ID, CPM, Accession,genome_annot) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = genome_annot,
    values_from = CPM,
    names_prefix = "CPM_"
  )
```

```{r}
# Calculate maternal ratios
cpm_ratios <- reshaped_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_TPM = CPM_accession + CPM_tair10,
    tair10_ratio = ifelse(total_TPM == 0, NA, CPM_tair10 / total_TPM),
    accession_ratio = ifelse(total_TPM == 0, NA, CPM_accession / total_TPM)
  )

# View results
head(cpm_ratios)
```
## Plot ratios 
```{r}
average_ratios <- cpm_ratios %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genotype, ID) %>% # Group by genotype (Col, ddm1) and TE. Average for TE 
  dplyr::summarise(avg_ratio = mean(tair10_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

## Average distribution of the TEs 
ggplot(average_ratios, aes(x = avg_ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "orange", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(data = filter(average_ratios, Genotype == "F1_ddm1"), 
           aes(xintercept = 0.7), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Genotype, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "Average maternal ratio",
       y = "Count") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Heatmap visualization 
```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(circlize)

boxplot_data_clean <- boxplot_data %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample_id, Variant, Genotype, ID, Accession, genome_annot, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Calculate log2fc between ddm1 and col0 
tes_upregulated <- boxplot_data_clean %>%
  filter(genome_annot == "tair10") %>%  # or "accession" depending on which genome you want
  dplyr::select(ID, Accession, Genotype, log2_CPM) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Genotype,
    values_from = log2_CPM,
    values_fn = mean
  ) %>%
  mutate(log2FC = F1_ddm1 - F1_Col) %>%
  filter(log2FC > 2)


##Filter TEs to be 0.7 maternally expressed
average_ratios_selected <- average_ratios[average_ratios$avg_ratio>=0.7,]

te_mat <- boxplot_data$ID %in% average_ratios_selected$ID
boxplot_data_mat_selected <- boxplot_data[te_mat,]

boxplot_data_mat_selected_significant <- boxplot_data_clean$ID %in% tes_upregulated$ID
boxplot_data_mat_selected_sig <-  boxplot_data_clean[boxplot_data_mat_selected_significant,]
# Prepare heatmap data

heatmap_data <- boxplot_data_clean %>% 
  mutate(sample_genome = paste(sample_id, genome_annot, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, sample_genome, log2_CPM) %>%
 pivot_wider(names_from = sample_genome, values_from = log2_CPM) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ID") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Create annotation with sorted order
col_annotation <- boxplot_data_clean %>%
  mutate(sample_genome = paste(sample_id, genome_annot, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_genome, Genotype, Variant, genome_annot) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(
    factor(Genotype, levels = c("F1_ddm1", "F1_Col", "ct_col", "ddm1_ct")),  # Genotype order
    genome_annot == "tair10"  # Within each genotype: tair10 first, then accession
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_genome")

# Match order to heatmap columns
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[, rownames(col_annotation)]

genome_colors <- c("accession" = "#E41A1C", "tair10" = "#377EB8")
genotype_colors <- c("F1_Col" = "#66C2A5", "F1_ddm1" = "#E62727", "ct_col" = "#5D866C", "ddm1_ct" = "#FFD93D")

# Create top annotation - genotype first (top), then genome (bottom)
col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Genotype = col_annotation$Genotype,
    'Mapped haplotype' = col_annotation$genome_annot,
    col = list(
        Genotype = genotype_colors,
        'Mapped haplotype' = genome_colors
    ),
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

# Create heatmap
Heatmap(
    heatmap_data,
    name = "log2(CPM+1)",
    top_annotation = col_ha,
    show_row_names = FALSE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
    clustering_method_rows = "complete",
    row_km_repeats = 1000,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    column_title = "Samples",
    row_title = "TE",
    column_title_side = "bottom",
    row_title_side = "left",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
        title = "log2(CPM+1)",
        direction = "vertical",
        legend_height = unit(4, "cm")))
```

######################################
##      Effect of the cross.        ##
######################################

```{r}
head(boxplot_data)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

col0_without_cross <- reshaped_data[reshaped_data$Accession=="6909" & reshaped_data$Genotype=="ddm1_ct",]
col0_with_cross <- reshaped_data[reshaped_data$Accession!="6909" &  reshaped_data$Genotype=="F1_ddm1",]


# Average across replicates first
col0_without_cross_avg <- col0_without_cross %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(CPM_tair10_without = mean(CPM_tair10, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

col0_with_cross_avg <- col0_with_cross %>%
  group_by(ID, Accession) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(CPM_tair10_with = mean(CPM_tair10, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Join
col_with_without_cross <- inner_join(
  col0_without_cross_avg, 
  col0_with_cross_avg, 
  by = "ID"
)

# Calculate statistics
cross_effect <- col_with_without_cross %>%
  group_by(Accession) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_TEs = n(),
    correlation = cor(log2(CPM_tair10_without + 1), log2(CPM_tair10_with + 1), 
                      use = "complete.obs"),
    mean_log2FC = mean(log2(CPM_tair10_with + 1) - log2(CPM_tair10_without + 1)),
    median_log2FC = median(log2(CPM_tair10_with + 1) - log2(CPM_tair10_without + 1)),
    n_increased = sum((CPM_tair10_with + 1) > (CPM_tair10_without + 1)),
    n_decreased = sum((CPM_tair10_with + 1) < (CPM_tair10_without + 1)),
    pct_increased = 100 * n_increased / n_TEs,
    pct_decreased = 100 * n_decreased / n_TEs
  )

ggplot(cross_effect, aes(x = correlation, y = reorder(Accession, correlation))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Correlation", y = "Accession") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16)

print(cross_effect)

# Visualize
col_with_without_cross_filt <- col_with_without_cross[col_with_without_cross$CPM_tair10_without>0 | col_with_without_cross$CPM_tair10_with>0,]
ggplot(col_with_without_cross_filt, 
       aes(log2(CPM_tair10_without + 1), log2(CPM_tair10_with + 1))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~ Accession) +
  labs(x = "log2(CPM Col-0 selfed tair10 allele + 1)", 
       y = "log2(CPM F1 tair10 allele + 1)",
       title = "Effect of crossing Col-0 with different accessions") +
  theme_bw()

## Calculate FC in TE
col_with_without_cross_filt$fc_te <- log2(col_with_without_cross_filt$CPM_tair10_with+1)- log2(col_with_without_cross_filt$CPM_tair10_without+1)

ggplot(col_with_without_cross_filt, aes(x = fc_te)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#2E86AB", color = "black") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)+vline(-5)
########################
### Analyse abundance
###############
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Filter TEs with >2-fold increase (fc_te > 1)
col_with_without_cross_filt_high <- col_with_without_cross_filt %>%
  filter(fc_te < -5)

# 2. Annotate with TE family information
col_with_without_cross_filt_high_ann <- col_with_without_cross_filt_high %>%
  left_join(te_annotation, by = c("ID" = "Transposon_Name"))

# 3. Count accessions per TE and calculate percentage
total_accessions <- n_distinct(col_with_without_cross_filt$Accession)

te_accession_counts <- col_with_without_cross_filt_high_ann %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_accessions = n_distinct(Accession),
    Transposon_Super_Family = first(Transposon_Super_Family)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = (n_accessions / total_accessions) * 100,
    ID_label = paste0(ID, " (", Transposon_Super_Family, ")")
  ) %>%
  filter(percent > 25) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent))

print(te_accession_counts)

# 4. Plot: Bar plot of TEs by percentage
ggplot(te_accession_counts, aes(x = reorder(ID, percent), y = percent)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#2E86AB", color = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "TE",
       y = "% of Accessions with decreased Expression",
       title = "TEs Increased in >25% of Accessions") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

# 5. Plot: Point plot with superfamily labels
ggplot(te_accession_counts, aes(x = percent, y = reorder(ID_label, percent))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#2E86AB") +
  labs(x = "% of Accessions with decreased Expression",
       y = "TE (Superfamily)",
       title = "TEs Increased Across Multiple Accessions") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))


```

## PCA on each superfamily
```{r}
# Get unique superfamilies
boxplot_data_mat_selected_superfamily <- left_join(boxplot_data_mat_selected,te_annotation, by=c("ID"="Transposon_Name"))
superfamilies <- unique(boxplot_data_mat_selected_superfamily$Transposon_Super_Family)
 

library(ggplot2)

# 1. Prepare data matrix for PCA (samples as rows, TEs as columns)
pca_data <- boxplot_data_mat_selected_superfamily %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, ID, log2_CPM, genome_annot, Genotype, Variant) %>%
  mutate(sample_genome = paste(sample_id, genome_annot, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_genome, ID, log2_CPM, Genotype, Variant, genome_annot) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ID, values_from = log2_CPM, values_fill = 0)

# 2. Extract metadata for coloring
pca_metadata <- pca_data %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_genome, Genotype, Variant, genome_annot)

# 3. Prepare matrix for PCA (only numeric columns)
pca_matrix <- pca_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-sample_genome, -Genotype, -Variant, -genome_annot) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(pca_matrix) <- pca_data$sample_genome

# 4. Perform PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(pca_matrix, scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)

# 5. Extract PC scores and merge with metadata
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_genome") %>%
  left_join(pca_metadata, by = "sample_genome")

# 6. Calculate variance explained
variance_explained <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, ] * 100

# 7. Plot PCA colored by genotype
ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Genotype)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of TE Expression (log2_CPM)",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(variance_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(variance_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
    color = "Genotype",
    shape = "Mapped Haplotype"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold")
  )




# Get TE loadings (contribution of each TE to PCs)
pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ID") %>%
  left_join(
    boxplot_data_mat_selected_superfamily %>% 
      dplyr::select(ID, Transposon_Family) %>% 
      distinct(),
    by = "ID"
  )

# Plot loadings colored by superfamily
ggplot(pca_loadings, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Transposon_Family)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA Loadings: TE Contribution",
    x = "PC1 Loading",
    y = "PC2 Loading",
    color = "TE Superfamily"
  )
```

## Calculate  presence for every accession
```{r}
insertions_upstream_gene_long <- insertions_upstream_gene %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Chr, Start_ins, Stop_ins, TE_family, Allele_freq, Chr_TSS, 
              feature, Start_TSS, Stop_TSS, Orientation_gene, gene, Distance_to_TSS),
    names_to = "Accession",
    values_to = "Value", 
    values_transform = list(Value=~as.numeric(na_if(.,"NA")))
  )
# Modify gene
insertions_upstream_gene_long$gene_id <- gsub("ID=", "", insertions_upstream_gene_long$gene)
insertions_upstream_gene_long$gene_id <- gsub( ";.*" , "", insertions_upstream_gene_long$gene_id)
```
## Get accessions with presence and absence
```{r}
insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value <- as.numeric(insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value)
insertions_upstream_gene_long_presence_acc <- insertions_upstream_gene_long[insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value==1 & !is.na(insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value),] # Select only presence 
insertions_upstream_gene_long_presence_acc$status <- "presence"

insertions_upstream_gene_long_absence_acc <- insertions_upstream_gene_long[insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value==0 & !is.na(insertions_upstream_gene_long$Value),] # Select only absence 
insertions_upstream_gene_long_absence_acc$status <- "absence"
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Calculate mean fold change between presence and absence for each gene/TE/genotype
heatmap_data <- presence_absence_df_with_info_mean %>%
  group_by(ID, TE_family, Genotype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_presence = mean(mean_expr_acc[status == "presence"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_absence = mean(mean_expr_acc[status == "absence"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

heatmap_data_check <- heatmap_data[heatmap_data$TE_family=="ATENSPM10",]
heatmap_data <- na.omit(heatmap_data)
heatmap_data$log2_fc <- heatmap_data$mean_presence-heatmap_data$mean_absence
heatmap_data_filt <-heatmap_data[heatmap_data$log2_fc> -9,]
# Create heatmap
heatmap_data_check %>% filter(Genotype=="F1_ddm1" | Genotype=="F1_Col") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = TE_family, y = ID, fill = log2_fc)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Genotype, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", 
    mid = "white", 
    high = "red",
    midpoint = -0,
    name = "Presence expr - Absence expr"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Expression Accessibility: Presence vs Absence",
    x = "TE Family",
    y = "Gene ID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "gray50"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Reshape data to have F1_Col and F1_ddm1 log2_fc in separate columns
heatmap_scatter <- heatmap_data_check %>%
  select(ID, TE_family, Genotype, log2_fc) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Genotype, values_from = log2_fc) %>%
  drop_na()  # Remove rows where either genotype is missing

# Create scatterplot
ggplot(heatmap_scatter, aes(x = F1_Col, y = F1_ddm1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Log2 FC (F1_Col)",
    y = "Log2 FC (F1_ddm1)",
    title = "Comparison of TE Effect on Expression",
    subtitle = "Log2 Fold Change: Presence vs Absence"
  )


```
